reason: I already drive to Jbeil every Saturday and catch the Tawfeer and supermarket offers myself, so paying $1.25 a bag to get half the saving is just giving away money. I also want to see and choose what I buy.
objection: I go to Jbeil anyway and follow the deals myself. Why pay a fee and only get half the saving, and trust someone else to pick the right brand and size?
would_change_my_mind: No fee at all and the full bulk saving passed on, or a week when I truly cannot get down to Jbeil.
